CH11 carries the connected side paths; CH10-c, CH10-d and CH10-e carry wellbeing, mobile and the interface respectively. The Chapter 0 naming-table continuation delivered below assigns documentary IDs only; it does not assign controlled component or Register IDs or change the frozen CH00 file.
